newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish PKO SA bank Q3 net rises to PLN 202 mln.
newsitem.headline: Polish PKO SA bank Q3 net rises to PLN 202 mln.

text.p: Polish state-owned commercial bank Polska Kasa Opieki SA's (PKO SA) net profit after the first nine months of this year rose to 201.8 million zlotys against 149.1 million in the same period of 1995, the bank said.
It said in a statement its gross profit in that period was 318.4 millon zlotys against 256 million in the same period of 1995.
PKO SA's balance sheet total was at 21.7 billion zlotys after the third quarter against 18.4 billion zlotys at the end of the third quarter of 1995. @
During the whole of 1995 PKO SA had a net profit of 300 million zlotys and its gross profit was 304 million.
